target: For every connected simply connected complete noncompact smooth Kahler manifold M of finite complex dimension n>=1 with nonnegative holomorphic bisectional curvature, M is biholomorphic to C^k times a finite product of irreducible compact Hermitian symmetric spaces, for some k>=1; empty compact product allowed. No curvature upper bound, volume growth, decay, or pinching assumption. No metric flatness conclusion for the C^k factor.
chronology: Recorded after source338 introduction/initial-data and Ni-Tam preliminary screening, before unified proof assembly. No completed proof exists.
